steps.say: Your watchlists decide what the dashboard shows: the signal tables, the chart, and your scans. | Let's set them up.
First, open Settings in the sidebar and choose the markets you trade: cryptos, equities, or both. | The other market's sections hide.
Then tick that step on the getting-started checklist.

Now open Watchlists, then Edit Crypto. | Type a name or a ticker, press Enter, and pick the match. | Here, Chainlink. | The first time anyone adds a coin, its readings are worked out and saved for everyone, so it takes a few seconds. | After that, it's instant.
Shares work the same way, in Edit Stocks. | Type a company or a ticker. Here, AMD. | Again, a new one takes a few seconds the first time.
Both now appear in the signal tables, with their Trend, Stretch and Flow readings.
To take one off, choose it under Remove, in the same place.
Three or more assets ticks the watchlist step by itself. | Your watchlists are saved on your account, on every device.
